name: stateful-button
title: Stateful Button
description: A rounded green submit button that spins up a loader while its click handler runs, then flashes a circled tick before settling back to its normal label.
use: A form submit or save action needs to show progress and confirm success in the same spot.
avoid: The green fill and two-second tick are fixed, so it takes a source edit to match another palette.
a11y: The busy and success states are not announced; only the icons change, with no aria-busy or live region. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide bright-green pill with bold white 'Submit' centred on near-black. On hover a second green ring appears around it; while busy a white spinner sits just before the words.
behaves: Clicking grows a small spinning arc beside the label, holds the button in place during the async work, then swaps the arc for a circled tick for two seconds before returning to the plain state.
customise: The label comes as children and button attributes pass through, with className for size and colour; loader timing and the two-second success hold are in the source.
weight: light: One button with short icon animations and a spinner only while busy.
